r: This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join the world's fastest growing startup as well as the biggest unicorn by valuation. With ByteDance's vision to build global platforms of creation and interaction, BytePlus is devoted to developing innovative technologies and products for businesses to fuel their next wave of growth. It is the best time to join us and pave into the new era together!

The Sales Development Representative /Inside Sales Specialist for the South Asia market will work closely with Marketing, Solution and User growth teams to collect and organize sales leads that fit well with our Tech2B products. You will be responsible for detecting market opportunities and developing leads across all channels, including marketing events, industry reports, blogs, social media, among others. You will ensure that our sales leads are of the highest quality, with the goal of targeting potential customers. Meanwhile, you are in charge of grading all the leads and distributing them to the hands of sales representatives in a timely manner.
Generating new business opportunities to fuel the Sales Pipeline
Conducting high level conversations with business owners in prospect accounts
Achieving monthly & quarterly quotas of Meetings Generated and Qualified Opportunities
Develop your sales skills, market understanding, solutions knowledge and customer approach to generate valuable business opportunities.
Attend training and coaching regularly and adopt proven selling methodology
